name: Dedica
summary: Agent-readiness checker that scores whether AI agents can find, use and pay on your website.
description: Dedica scans a site the way AI agents browse it and returns an agent-readiness score with prioritized fixes and handable prompts for coding agents. Differentiator is GEO/agent navigation checks (discovery, access, actions, payments) plus an optional agent-facing version of the site and MCP endpoints. Free covers a limited score and top fixes; Pro is $79/month for more pages and agent payments; a one-time fix kit is also sold.
features: Prioritized fixes with prompts for coding agents
Checks for discovery, access, actions and payments
Optional agent-facing version of the site and MCP endpoints
